# RSS Feeds

From your computer, tablet and mobile phone, access the latest news available on **France 24**'s
website.

Among the list below, select the RSS feeds you are **interested** in and click on the RSS reader
you use.

You will then start receiving the latest news in **real time** about the **topics**
or **geographical areas** you've selected.
